prompts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a production-ready 2 by 2 animation sprite sheet (four equal landscape panels, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), ideally 1536 x 1024 or larger. Image 1 is a REFERENCE for character identities, action and horizontal positions; image 2 is a REFERENCE ONLY for the crisp high-resolution rendering quality. Generate genuinely crisp new line art, do not enlarge the blurry original. White background, clean Japanese elementary school textbook cartoon, smooth black outlines, flat warm shading. The same two friendly black-haired boys in every panel: orange long-sleeve shirt receiver on LEFT facing left, teal green shirt actor on RIGHT facing left, navy pants, charcoal sneakers. Entire figures visible, feet near 92% panel height; left person's torso centered at 30% panel width, right person's torso at 80%. Keep body scale, identity, face, clothing, camera, ground level and composition identical across the four panels; only tiny action changes. No captions, numbers, letters, arrows, speech balloons, added characters or decorations. Exactly one thin medium-gray vertical line at center and one horizontal line at center divide panels; no gaps or inset frames. Every panel has the SAME aspect ratio 3:2.
ACTION: Recreate ONLY the bottom row pushing action from reference image 1, rearranged into a 2x2 sheet. In all panels orange boy at left stands in front, green boy behind at right. Frame 1: green boy extends open hands toward orange boy's upper back with a small visible gap. Frame 2: both open palms touch the orange boy's back (never his face or chest). Frame 3: green boy leans forward gently pushing; orange boy takes a small step toward LEFT, no fall and no distress. Frame 4: orange boy remains a little forward, green boy hands released just behind the back. Preserve left/orange and right/green roles. Cartoon friendly movement, no violence. Maintain left boy center near30%, green80%, no clipping.

ACTION: Recreate ONLY the FIRST row rope-pulling action from reference image 1, rearranged into a 2x2 sheet. Orange boy on left faces left, with a thick orange soft rope around his waist, no knots on neck, no wrist restraints. Green boy on right holds the free length of rope with both hands, pulling it toward the RIGHT. Frame 1: rope slack in a shallow U, orange boy relaxed. Frame 2: green boy grips firmly, slack reduced. Frame 3: green boy leans slightly to the right, rope taut, orange boy's torso is gently tugged backward toward RIGHT, small surprised smile. Frame 4: rope stays taut and boys settle. Do NOT swap persons or positions. Not tug-of-war: rope encircles orange boy's waist, and only green boy holds rope in his hands. No injury, danger or distress.

ACTION: Recreate ONLY the SECOND row water-pistol action from reference image 1, rearranged into a 2x2 sheet. Orange boy left faces left; green boy right faces left and holds exactly one blue/yellow/green playful water pistol aimed LEFT at orange boy's upper back. Frame 1: water pistol ready, no water or droplets yet. Frame 2: a short thin blue stream starts from the LEFT-pointing nozzle and travels LEFT but has not hit the back yet. Frame 3: continuous blue water stream travels from nozzle directly onto orange boy's upper back, clear small splashes around his back, orange boy cheerful surprised face. Frame 4: water stream stopped, pistol lowered slightly, a few blue droplets remain on the orange shirt. Keep boys almost stationary across frames; all changes must be in water and arm pose. Never aim at the face. No extra puddles or watery background.
